channel.title: Deep Press Analysis — English Feed

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — September 1, 2026
item.description: Strategic analysis of global capital restructuring. Today's focus: the systemic impacts of the new U.S. tariff regime, the $40 trillion fiscal dominance crisis, China's weaponization of critical minerals, and the nuclear renaissance driven by AI energy demands.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 31, 2026
item.description: Strategic forensic accounting analysis of offshore network deconstruction. Today's focus: dismantling dark capital architecture, FATF regulations, SEC Schedule 13D/G amendments, and a practical case study exposing hidden beneficial ownership.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 30, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of global media narratives. Today's focus: how technocratic consensus and transnational capital invalidate traditional political sovereignty, masking class shifts via economic determinism and algorithmic management.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 29, 2026
item.description: A comprehensive global report on institutional corruption and the revolving door mechanism. Today's focus: how transnational corporations legally purchase insider access and regulatory protection.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 28, 2026
item.description: A structural assessment of the cognitive warfare domain. Today's focus: how supranational institutions and defense cartels execute semantic hacking to legitimize the expropriation of public wealth for European militarization.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 27, 2026
item.description: Strategic deconstruction of global markets. Today's focus: the asymmetry of the US-China semiconductor war, the collapse of Big Tech's Section 230 legal shield, and the commoditization of creative labor and human vulnerabilities.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 26, 2026
item.description: Research report on Trae Stephens: an analysis of his architecture of influence, capital structure, and role as a systemic integrator bridging Silicon Valley venture capital and the U.S. defense complex.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 25, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of Thomas Joseph Barrack Jr. as a transnational operator and system of influence. Today's focus: analyzing his model of converting capital into political access and leveraging geopolitical crises in the Middle East into corporate assets.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 24, 2026
item.description: An in-depth structural analysis of XRG Corporation (formerly ADNOC International). We explore how Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth is being strategically converted into global jurisdictional, infrastructural, and political control to hedge against escalating physical risks in the Middle East.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 23, 2026
item.description: A strategic deep dive into Euroclear's architecture as a transnational financial monopoly, detailing its role as a geopolitical gatekeeper, its structural capitalization via frozen Russian assets, and systemic liquidity risks.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 22, 2026
item.description: A comprehensive analytical deep-dive into the power architecture of Mohammed Al-Jadaan, Saudi Arabia's Minister of Finance. We explore his systemic role, fiscal control, institutional leverage, and the recalibration of Vision 2030.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 21, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of Larry Fink's architecture of power. Today's focus: analyzing BlackRock's transition from dominating public ETF markets to capturing private credit and physical AI infrastructure, while navigating geopolitical vulnerabilities and antitrust risks.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 20, 2026
item.description: A strategic analysis of Jeremy Allaire as an architectural node of financial influence, detailing how Circle's USDC is being integrated directly into the U.S. governmental and institutional financial apparatus.

item.title: Deep Press Analysis — August 19, 2026
item.description: Strategic assessment of Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI). Today's focus: analyzing SSI's 'Financial Architect' strategy, its unprecedented $9 billion capitalization without commercial products, and its aggressive hardware monopolization via Nvidia.
